title: No but seriously just imagining Jeremy doing the “Splish Splash” danc...
transcript: We finally know who is replacing Jonathan Groff in just in time, it is Mr. Jeremy Jordan. And, like, yeah, that makes sense. If you're going through the Broadway tenors, it's like, well, Aaron Tveit's busy, Derek Cline is busy. Let's get Jeremy Jordan. And I think he'll be great. He'll obviously sing the role really well. I loved the little moments in Gatsby where he got to dance, and so I'm really excited to see him do more dancing. I think him doing the Splish Splash dance is gonna be really endearing. I do think, acting wise, he's gonna be very different than Jonathan Groff. Jonathan's Bobby is very smooth, confident, debonair, whereas Jeremy Jordan tends to play more adorkable characters, these kind of lovable goofballs. Even his Gatsby, which is normally a very suave, debonair character, he kind of leaned into, like, the nervous energy. And I suspect we'll probably see something similar with his Bobby Darren. And, of course, I expect them to throw in some references to Gatsby and Newsies in the same way that Jonathan Groff talked about his spitting. I'm sure they're gonna customize it for him, and I'm really excited to see what he does with the role, especially after seeing Matt Magnuson, who also had a very different take on Bobby. I'm excited to see what Jeremy does with it.
